articles.title: Perplexity Introduces Photon: A Rust-Based Retrieval Engine That Cuts p99 Latency From 800 ms to 65 ms
articles.summary: Perplexity has released Photon, an in-house retrieval and ranking engine written in Rust. It replaces an open-source engine Perplexity had forked for its AI-native search stack. Photon now handles retrieval and ranking for all production traffic. It also powers a new Fast Search mode in the Perplexity Search API. articles.summary: pnpm 11.28.3 updates undici to clear a security advisory, fixes "database disk image is malformed" errors when several pnpm processes share a store, and makes packages, catalogs, projects, and commands named like constructor work. articles.title: pnpm 12.8.2
articles.summary: pnpm 12.8.2 fixes a startup crash on Linux ppc64le and UnknownIssuer errors on systems without CA certificates. pnpm run no longer installs before every script on CI when autoDedupe is enabled, and resolution and hoisted installs on macOS are faster. Patch Changes Platforms and environments Fixed pnpm crashing on startup on Linux ppc64le #16380 . Fixed installs failing with UnknownIssuer on Linux systems without CA certificates, such as node:24-slim , when NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS is set.
